House Favorites

Start with the signatures

Grab it on your way up the stairs, or settle in and stay a while. These four come first because they are what regulars actually order, and what a first visit should taste like.

Signature Drink

Dirty Chai

Mad Hat chai with a shot of Lighthouse espresso. Warm spice first, coffee right behind it, steamed milk over the top.

Why it leads: the drink people cross campus for

Signature Sandwich

Freebird Turkey Sandwich

From Memoranda Kitchen. Stacked turkey, crisp lettuce and tomato on hearty sliced bread, cut in half so you can see every layer.

Why it leads: the lunch regulars run a tab for

House Favorite

Peanut Butter Breve Cappuccino

Espresso under a thick cap of peanut butter breve foam. Rich, nutty, and poured to order at the counter.

Why it is here: the premium pour that makes the rest feel easy

Everyday Classic

Latte

A double shot of Lighthouse espresso with steamed milk and a clean leaf on top. Simple, warm, and made the same way since the early days.

Fun fact: a 16 oz latte was $2.50 when Metro opened in 2004

Your All-Day Stop

More Than a Morning Spt

Pastries & Breakfast

Marsee Bakery scones, muffins, and croissants, baked fresh and ready before you have had your coffee. Flaky, buttery, and gone by afternoon on a good day. No judgment if breakfast is just a croissant.

Coffee

Lighthouse Roasters beans in every cup. Whether it is a straight shot of espresso or the Dirty Chai, we help put the mmm in your morning ritual. Owner Stef started as a barista here, and her own daily drink is a simple Americano.

Tea & Lunch

More than 25 Mad Hat teas on the wall, plus Memoranda Kitchen sandwiches worth taking your lunch break for. The Freebird is the one to start with. Seriously.

The Menu Board

Order at the counter

The full board, in plain text you can read on your phone on the way up the stairs. No PDF to pinch and zoom, no app to download.

How to order Order at the counter. Non-dairy milks and a wall of syrups if you want to build your own. Regulars can run a tab - just ask.
  • Signature - first pour

    Dirty Chai

    Mad Hat chai, a shot of espresso, and steamed milk. Warm, spiced, and awake.

  • Peanut Butter Breve Cappuccino

    Espresso capped with thick peanut butter breve foam. The rich one.

  • Americano

    Lighthouse espresso and hot water, clean and strong. Stef's daily drink.

  • Latte

    Double shot, steamed milk, leaf latte art. The everyday classic.

  • Cappuccino

    Equal parts espresso, steamed milk, and airy foam, dusted on top.

  • Espresso

    A straight double shot of Lighthouse Roasters espresso.

  • Chai Latte

    Mad Hat chai steamed with milk, no espresso. All spice, no jitters.

  • Hot Cocoa

    Cocoa, steamed milk, and whipped cream. The between-classes warmer.

  • Iced Drinks

    Your favorite, over ice. Ask at the counter what is pouring cold today.

  • Build Your Own

    Start with espresso or chai, pick your milk, add a syrup from the wall.

  • Start here

    Mad Hat Teas

    More than 25 teas from Mad Hat Tea. Ask what is steeping, or pick a favorite and make it yours.

  • Dirty Chai

    The signature, listed here too because half of campus finds it from the tea side first.

  • Chai Latte

    Spiced chai and steamed milk, warm all the way through.

  • Hot Cocoa

    For the friend who came for the company, not the caffeine.

  • Signature - start here

    Freebird Turkey Sandwich

    Memoranda Kitchen's stacked turkey sandwich with crisp lettuce and tomato. The lunch order regulars repeat.

  • Memoranda Kitchen Sandwiches

    A rotating case from Memoranda Kitchen. Ask at the counter what came in today.

  • Scones & Muffins

    From Marsee Bakery. Buttery, crumbly, and best while they are still warm.

  • Croissants & Pastries

    Flaky layers from Marsee Bakery. Baked fresh daily, and they do sell out.

A Little About Us

Since 2004

Metro started with a simple idea: a real, independent coffee shop right at the heart of UW Tacoma. It opened in September 2004 in the historic Tioga Library Building. Stef, who started here as a barista, now owns the shop. In fall 2024, Metro celebrated 20 years on campus.

Almost everything here comes from nearby: Lighthouse Roasters coffee, Marsee Bakery pastries, Mad Hat teas, and Memoranda Kitchen sandwiches.

When it opened, a 16 oz latte was $2.50. The steps, the regulars, and the first-sip mmm have not changed.

Proudly serving: Lighthouse Roasters · Marsee Bakery · Mad Hat Tea · Memoranda Kitchen
